phrases: 表示存在，用于介绍某处有某物
There is a table in the room.
There are some books on the stereo.
表示在窗户附近的位置
The television is near the window.
The pictures are on the wall.
The stereo is near the door.
表示在桌子附近的位置
The armchairs are near the table.
表示在电视上面的位置
There are some magazines on the television.
表示在桌子上面的位置
There are some newspapers on the table.

grammar.f: There is/are + (a/an/some) + 名词 + 介词短语
grammar.d: 用于表示某处存在某人或某物，是英语中描述位置和存在的重要句型 当名词是单数或不可数名词时用there is；当名词是复数时用there are。some用于肯定句，any用于否定句和疑问句
ex: There is a television in the room.
There are some armchairs in the room.

grammar.f: some + 可数名词复数/不可数名词；any + 可数名词复数/不可数名词
grammar.d: some和any都表示“一些”，但用法有所不同 some用于肯定句，any用于否定句和疑问句。但在表示请求或希望得到肯定回答的疑问句中，也可用some
ex: There are some magazines on the television.
Are there any books on the stereo?

patterns.p: There is + (a/an) + 单数名词 + 介词短语
o: There is a television in the room.
im: There is a table in the room.
There is a stereo in the room.

patterns.p: There are + some + 复数名词 + 介词短语
o: There are some armchairs in the room.
im: There are some pictures in the room.
There are some magazines on the television.

patterns.p: 主语 + is/are + 介词短语
o: The television is near the window.
im: The stereo is near the door.
The pictures are on the wall.
